entries.land_description: (25 miles NE of Palm Springs in a rural desert area). We are two lesbian feminists, lovers of 15 years. We have been rural wimmin for 9 years, 3 years of which on our farm. We raise our own vegetables, herbs, chickens, goats, bees, fruit trees; many flowers. We live simply and creatively (no TV) and do enjoy sharing our skills with wimmin oriented lesbians (non-racist, non-classist etc) interested in rural life.
A thriving commercial dairy and cheeseplant, truck gardening, various homestead animals and horses. Six dwellings with all conveniences, spa, greenhouse, pond, barns, pasture.
entries.notes: I welcome lesbians to lease out part of commercial operations or buy shares in the property. Requires money and responsibility. Must have country-living-animal experience and be interested, as well as believe in, ecologically run, woman owned commercial farming. NO DRUGS.

entries.land_description: Wilderness Way is located on 10 wooded acres with 260 feet of lake frontage. There are 3 two bedroom housekeeping units each with fully equipped kitchen and bath, and living room area. The campground includes electric hook-ups, indoor bathroom facilities with hot showers and an indoor camper lounge area. Swimming, fishing, canoeing, bicycling, hiking, horseback riding and cross country skiing.
